description: Instance user data is a plain-text value per key, not a scaleway.std.File. The spec declares SetServerUserData's body as `*/*` `format: binary` (which the converter drops, leaving the PATCH with no body at all) and GetServerUserData's 200 as the JSON `scaleway.std.File` message. The wire is `PATCH …/user_data/{key}` with a `text/plain` body of the raw content, answered 204, and `GET …/user_data/{key}` answering the raw content as `text/plain`. Source: the official JS SDK replaces both generated methods by hand (packages_generated/instance/src/v1/api.utils.ts, `setServerUserData` sends `body: request.content` with `Content-Type: text/plain`; `getServerUserData` returns `fetch<string>`); the Go SDK does the same in instance/v1/instance_utils.go.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The user data content, sent verbatim as `text/plain`.
